title: Tiling + tissue segmentation + MPP/magnification normalization pipeline
context: After ingest and de-id re-scan, slides with deidStatus: passed or manual-cleared can be tiled into patches for downstream ML tasks. A critical correctness requirement is MPP (microns-per-pixel) normalization: TCGA/TCIA slides are scanned at varying magnifications (20x, 40x); without normalization, a model may exploit resolution artifacts rather than biology. Tissue segmentation is required to avoid tiling empty background. The preprocessing pipeline must be fully reproducible from a pinned config and produce a stable preprocessing hash recorded in every result. This pipeline is an adapter (Python/OpenSlide) isolated from the agent-neutral core. See PLAN.md (Data layer, MPP/magnification normalization).
objective: Implement the WSI tiling, tissue segmentation, and MPP/magnification normalization pipeline as a Python adapter: tile de-id-passed slides into patches at a declared microns-per-pixel target (so 20x and 40x scanners are comparable), apply tissue-detection segmentation to exclude background tiles, record per-slide MPP and scanner in the manifest, and produce a stable preprocessing hash from the pinned config. Derived tiles inherit provenance and source license from the parent slide record. The pipeline is reproducible from a pinned config file.
acceptanceCriteria: Tiling and tissue segmentation are reproducible from a pinned configuration file; the config produces a stable preprocessing hash.
Slides are resampled to a declared microns-per-pixel target so 20x and 40x scanner outputs are comparable.
Per-slide MPP and scanner/vendor are recorded in the manifest (matching the provenance schema from pathology-image-benchmarks-prov-001).
Background tiles are excluded by a tissue-detection segmentation step.
Derived tiles inherit provenance (source collection, accession, license, deidStatus) and source license from the parent slide manifest record.
Only slides with deidStatus: passed or manual-cleared are tiled; unscanned or quarantined slides are excluded.
The pipeline is implemented as a Python adapter (e.g. adapters/wsi-python/) isolated from the agent-neutral TypeScript core.
pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass; CI provenance gate passes on derived tile manifests.
output: A tiling + tissue segmentation + MPP-normalization pipeline PR (Python adapter), with a pinned config, preprocessing-hash output, and provenance-carrying tile manifests.
